items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Ella Fitzgerald was with him. ... No, nobody is going to sound like Ella. But Ella was always trying to improve

ctx.x: Well, I do know him. I have --
-- Harry James' band all the time. And he also played with Ella Fitzgerald while I was there.
And I think he's around New York now, isn't he?
